newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end firm despite weaker Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end firm despite weaker Wall St.

text.p: Portuguese ended higher with other European markets despite the weakness at the opening in New York. Turnover was 9.1 billion escudos, slightly above the recent daily average.
* Shares in cement firm Cimpor showed little reaction to its 1996 results, which showed a 7.3 percent increase. Cimpor closed at 3,510 escudos, up 20, in volume of 332,913 shares.

* Retailer Sonae Investimentos attracted strong interest from foreign investors, pushing the stock to a high of 5,615 escudos. Sonae Investimentos closed at 5,600 escudos, up 122, in volume of 327,825 shares.

* Operators said that they expected a calm session tomorrow with the Oporto Derivatives Exchange closed. Many investment funds were squaring positions ahead of the end of the month and quarter, dealers said. Lisbon bourse will close on Friday and Monday for Easter. "I think tomorrow's session will be calm and there will probably be negligible activity in the afternoon. The funds could close some portfolios," said one operator.
